intro: Jalna is a Marathwada town known for its steel re-rolling mills and its seed companies, about 320 km from our factory in Vasai. Schools, housing colonies and factory campuses here ask us for playground equipment, and FunPlay Systems sends every order by road and installs it on site. Rainfall in this part of Maharashtra is low and uncertain, and that affects one step of the job buyers rarely think about.

Grouted equipment sits on concrete foundations, and fresh concrete needs water for several days to cure properly. If it dries too fast in the Marathwada heat, the foundation can crack and the posts may loosen later. Before we install, we check with you that water will be available for curing, even in a dry spell or when the site depends on tankers. On paved or firm ground, self-standing installation avoids the question altogether.

sections.h: Curing foundations in a dry town
sections.html:
Once the posts are set, the concrete around them should be kept damp, usually by sprinkling water or covering it with wet sacking. Do this in the early morning and evening, when the sun is gentler. Keep the play area closed until our crew confirms the foundations are ready, since an early load can crack them. Schedule installation away from the hottest weeks of April and May if you can, and lay rubber flooring only after curing is complete.

See our Double Post Swing and Horse Rider, or playground equipment in Aurangabad.

faq.q: Why does concrete need curing for playground equipment?
faq.a: Fresh concrete gains strength slowly and needs moisture to do so. If it dries too fast in hot weather it can crack, and posts set in it may loosen over time.

faq.q: Is there an installation method that needs no concrete?
faq.a: Self-standing installation, where the equipment rests on its own base, suits firm paved ground or slabs. On open soil we usually grout the posts for stability.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Jalna?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Jalna by road, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it according to your approved layout drawing. Send us the site size and photos first, and we will suggest the right method for your ground.

intro: Jamalpur, beside Munger on the Ganga, is home to one of India's oldest railway workshops, and the town has a long history of working with steel. Buyers here tend to ask detailed questions about how equipment is made, and we are glad to answer them. FunPlay Systems designs and fabricates playground equipment at our own factory in Vasai, about 1,540 km away, and sends it to Bihar by road.

Two materials do most of the work in our equipment. Frames are made from galvanised steel pipe, while slides, panels, seats and roofs are roto-moulded plastic. Both are shaped in-house, and our raw materials are tested and certified before use. Knowing how each one behaves helps you look after it properly through Bihar's hot summers and humid monsoon. Our in-house quality inspection checks each piece before it leaves the factory, and we can explain any part of the process you want to understand.

sections.h: How our main materials hold up outdoors
sections.html:
Galvanising bonds a layer of zinc to the steel pipe, and that layer goes on protecting the steel even where the surface gets scratched. Our galvanised pipes carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Roto-moulding forms plastic parts in a heated, rotating mould, which gives a hollow one-piece shape with rounded edges and no joints to open up. Composite laminates and play rope, used on some ranges, are also covered for 3 years.

See our CoreCraft range, or playground equipment in Munger.

faq.q: What is the difference between galvanised and painted steel?
faq.a: Galvanised steel has a zinc coating bonded to it, which keeps protecting the steel when scratched. Painted steel starts to rust as soon as the paint chips, especially in a humid monsoon.

faq.q: Why are slides and panels roto-moulded?
faq.a: Roto-moulding makes strong, hollow, one-piece parts with rounded edges and colour right through the plastic. They do not rust, and they clean easily with water and a soft cloth.

faq.q: Do you supply Jamalpur and Munger?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory to Jamalpur, Munger and nearby towns by road, and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: Jamnagar sits on the Gulf of Kutch, a city of brass-parts workshops, defence bases and the large refinery townships that have grown up nearby. Township parks here can be big, and one site often has to serve toddlers, schoolchildren and teenagers at once. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for such parks at our factory in Vasai, about 450 km away, and sends it to Gujarat by road.

A large park works best when it is divided into zones. Each zone suits one age group and has its own safe play area, with paths and seating in between. Our NexLev series includes larger play towers that can anchor the main zone, while CoreCraft individual pieces fill the toddler corner. The coast brings salt air and the summers are long and hot, so we use galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts throughout.

sections.h: Planning zones in a large township park
sections.html:
Place the toddler zone nearest the entrance and the seating, with low slides, spring riders and a small play station. Put the junior zone next, built around a multi play system with slides and climbers. The older children's zone can take a tall tower, nets and a merry-go-round, set furthest from the gate. Run a walking path around the outside so adults pass every zone without crossing any of them. Add shade and benches where the zones meet.

See our NexLev Solitaire towers, or playground equipment in Junagadh.

faq.q: How do you plan a playground for a large township park?
faq.a: We divide the park into zones by age group, each with its own safe play area, and connect them with paths and seating. The layout drawing shows every zone before you approve the order.

faq.q: Does salt air affect playground equipment in Jamnagar?
faq.a: Coastal air speeds up rust on bare or painted steel. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts resist it well, and a regular rinse with fresh water stops salt from building up.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Jamnagar?
faq.a: Yes. We send orders from our Vasai factory to Jamnagar by road and install them through our own team or a dealer in Gujarat. Townships, schools and defence colonies can all order directly.

intro: Jamshedpur grew around one of India's oldest steel plants and was planned from the start, and its parks, schools and company townships have long been run to clear standards. Many buyers here prepare a written specification or tender before they ask for quotes. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment against such specifications from our factory in Vasai, about 1,430 km away, delivered to Jharkhand by road.

A good specification describes what the equipment must do and what it is made of, without tying you to one supplier's model names. It gives every bidder the same target and makes quotes easy to compare. If you are drafting one, we can share the technical details of our products, including product area, safe play area, recommended age group and materials. That helps your engineers set requirements that match real equipment.

sections.h: What to include in a playground specification
sections.html:
• The age groups to be served and the number of children expected at one time.
  • Materials, for example galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts.
  • Product area and safe play area for each item, with impact-absorbing flooring over the safe zone.
  • Warranty period by component, installation method and the after-sales contact.

Our warranty is 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts. Our Play Lands product pages show typical details, or see playground equipment in Bokaro.

faq.q: Can you quote against our tender specification?
faq.a: Yes. Share the specification and site details, and we will quote for equipment that meets it. Where one of our products differs from a requirement, we say so clearly in the quote.

faq.q: Where can we find product dimensions and safe play areas?
faq.a: Each product page on our website lists the product area, safe play area and age group. We can also send these details together in a table for your engineers. Ask for them early, before the tender goes out.

faq.q: Do you supply company townships in Jamshedpur?
faq.a: Yes. Townships, schools, clubs and housing colonies in Jamshedpur can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: Jaunpur lies on the Gomti in eastern Uttar Pradesh, an old town known for its mosques, its stone bridge and its many schools and colleges. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment here from our factory in Vasai, about 1,230 km away. Orders travel by road, and our installation team or a dealer in North India sets them up on site. The town's very hot summers and cold winters are well within what our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for.

When you order matters almost as much as what you order. This part of the state has a scorching summer, a heavy monsoon and a cold, foggy winter. Foundation work goes best in the drier, milder months, and schools usually want the play area ready when classes reopen after the summer break. Working back from that date gives you a sensible time to approve the layout and place the order, with a margin for weather.

sections.h: Choosing the right time to install
sections.html:
October to March is usually the easiest window for outdoor civil work in Jaunpur, after the rains and before the worst heat. Concrete cures more evenly in mild weather, and the ground is firm enough for digging. If a school wants the play area ready after the summer vacation, approve the layout well before the break. Avoid planning foundations for the peak monsoon weeks, when pits fill with water. Leave enough time for drawing, approval, manufacture and dispatch.

See our Jambore 5 station, or playground equipment in Varanasi.

faq.q: When is the best season to install playground equipment in Jaunpur?
faq.a: The drier, milder months after the monsoon are usually easiest for foundation work. Plan your order so installation falls in that window, and avoid the peak monsoon weeks.

faq.q: Can you install during the summer vacation?
faq.a: Yes, if the order is approved in good time. Curing concrete needs care in hot weather, so we plan watering of the foundations with you before the crew arrives.

faq.q: Do you supply schools in Jaunpur?
faq.a: Yes. Schools, colleges and colonies in Jaunpur can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in North India.

intro: Jehanabad is a district town in south Bihar, between Patna and Gaya, surrounded by farmland. Its schools, panchayats and community grounds often have open land with no boundary at all. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,400 km away, and sends it to Bihar by road.

On an open ground, the play area has to be protected from more than the weather. Stray cattle wander in, motorcycles cut across, and the equipment may be used at night by people other than children. A simple fence with a gate turns the play area into a defined space that is easier to keep clean and safe. We plan the fence line on the layout drawing, outside every safe play area, so it never sits in the path of a swing or slide.

sections.h: Fencing and boundaries for an open site
sections.html:
Leave a clear gap between the fence and the outer edge of each safe play area. Use one gate, placed away from the road, and keep it latched so small children cannot run out. A low wall or fence also keeps animals off the rubber flooring, which hooves can damage. Inside the boundary, a bench or two lets parents sit and keep watch. Bihar's summers are very hot, so plant a line of trees along the fence for shade in the years ahead.

See our Four Seater Merry-Go-Round, or playground equipment in Bihar Sharif.

faq.q: Should a playground on open land be fenced?
faq.a: Yes, where possible. A fence with one latched gate keeps out animals and vehicles and defines the play area. We plan the fence line outside every safe play area on the layout.

faq.q: Do you supply the fencing as well?
faq.a: Our range covers play equipment, outdoor gym equipment, garden decor and rubber flooring. Fencing is usually built locally, and we give your contractor the layout so it goes in the right place.

faq.q: Can a panchayat or government school in Jehanabad order from you?
faq.a: Yes. Share the site size, photos and age group. We send a layout drawing and itemised quote for approval, then manufacture at Vasai and install through our team or a dealer.

intro: Jhansi, in the Bundelkhand region on the border of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, is known to schoolchildren across India for Rani Lakshmibai and her fort. Schools here often want a playground that carries something of Indian culture. FunPlay Systems designs and makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 890 km away, and sends it to Jhansi by road.

Our Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and several draw on games Indian children have played for generations. The Timeless Play series includes Chausar, based on the board game, Fugadi, a revolving pole named after the folk dance, and Patang, a swing set built around kite shapes. For a school, these become a starting point for stories and lessons as well as play. Bundelkhand's summers are very hot, so we plan shade into every layout.

sections.h: Bringing Indian games into the school playground
sections.html:
Chausar is a large structure with a central tower, slides and climbers set out in the cross shape of the board, so it suits a school with a good-sized ground. Patang fits a smaller space, with kite-shaped panels, swings and hanging rings. Teachers can link both to lessons on traditional games and festivals. Place swings in open ground and taller towers where afternoon shade falls. Our Khel Khud series also takes ideas from Indian play.

See Chausar and Patang, or playground equipment in Gwalior.

faq.q: Do you make playground equipment inspired by Indian games?
faq.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals include the Timeless Play series, with structures such as Chausar, Fugadi and Patang, and the Khel Khud series, both drawing on Indian games.

faq.q: How much space does Chausar need?
faq.a: It is one of our larger structures and needs a good-sized ground with clear space all round. The product page lists its safe play area, and we check the fit on your layout drawing.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Jhansi?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Jhansi and the rest of Bundelkhand by road, and install it with our own team or a dealer in North India. The heat of a Bundelkhand summer is something we plan for with shade on every layout.

intro: Jodhpur, the Blue City, sits on the edge of the Thar desert below Mehrangarh fort. Summers are long and extremely hot, rain is scarce and much of the ground around the city is sandy or rocky. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for schools, cantonment areas, hotels and housing colonies here from our factory in Vasai, about 770 km away, delivered by road.

Sand looks like a soft, natural surface for a play area, and in a desert town it is everywhere. In practice it causes trouble. Loose sand gets very hot by midday, blows onto slides and into bearings, and hides litter and sharp objects. It also shifts, so the level under a swing soon becomes a hollow. We usually suggest a firm, compacted base with rubber flooring on top. If you want sand play, keep it to a separate, shaded sand corner away from the main equipment.

sections.h: Foundations and surfaces on sandy ground
sections.html:
Loose sand gives posts little grip, so we grout equipment on a proper concrete base set into firmer ground below. On rocky patches, pits may need to be cut into stone. Over the finished base, rubber flooring gives an even, cushioned surface that does not blow away and is quick to sweep. Brush sand off slides and platforms daily in the windy months, since grit scratches plastic and wears moving parts. Shade from trees or a pergola keeps surfaces usable through the long summer.

See our Crawling Tunnel and Wave Slide, or playground equipment in Pali.

faq.q: Is sand a good surface under playground equipment in Jodhpur?
faq.a: Loose sand gets very hot, blows onto equipment and shifts under swings. A compacted base with rubber flooring stays level and comfortable to use, and it is easier to keep clean.

faq.q: How do you anchor equipment in sandy soil?
faq.a: We grout each post into a concrete base that reaches firmer ground, and on rocky patches the pits are cut into stone. Self-standing installation suits paved courtyards.

faq.q: Do you supply hotels and schools in Jodhpur?
faq.a: Yes. Hotels, schools, cantonment areas and housing colonies can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in Rajasthan.

intro: Jorhat is a tea town in Upper Assam, home to tea research and the gateway to Majuli island on the Brahmaputra. It is green, humid and wet for much of the year. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for schools, tea estates and colonies here at our factory in Vasai, about 2,320 km away, and sends it to Assam by road.

In weather this damp, the commonest everyday hazard on a playground is a slippery surface. Shady corners stay wet long after rain, and moss and algae grow on paving, steps and the edges of rubber flooring. Equipment under heavy tree cover gets the worst of it. When we plan your layout, we look at where the sun reaches the site, so the play area can dry out between showers. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts cope well with the damp, but the ground around them needs care.

sections.html:
Place the play area where it gets some direct sun each day, and trim branches that keep it in permanent shade. Sweep fallen leaves often, since a wet layer of leaves holds moisture and feeds moss. Scrub any green film off steps and rubber flooring with water and a stiff brush. Use only a soft cloth on plastic parts and slides. Check that water drains away from the base after every heavy shower.

See our Jungle Jive L1 station, or playground equipment in Dibrugarh.

faq.q: Why does playground equipment get slippery in Jorhat?
faq.a: Constant damp and shade let moss and algae grow on surfaces. Give the play area some sun, sweep leaves often and scrub any green film off the flooring and steps.

faq.q: Can tea estates order playground equipment from you?
faq.a: Yes. Tea estates, schools and colonies in and around Jorhat can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through a dealer in the Northeast or our own team. Our galvanised and roto-moulded materials suit the wet climate of the estates.

faq.q: How should we clean plastic slides and decks?
faq.a: Rinse them with water and wipe with a soft cloth. Avoid harsh scrubbing pads and strong chemicals, which can scratch the surface and make it hold dirt more easily.

intro: Junagadh sits at the foot of Mount Girnar, with the Gir forest, home of the Asiatic lion, a short distance away. Children here grow up with the forest close by, which makes a jungle theme a natural choice for a school or resort play area. FunPlay Systems designs and makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 350 km away, and sends it to Saurashtra by road.

Our Forestia range is a set of jungle-themed play stations, and other pieces in our catalogue take their shapes from animals and plants. A themed play area gives children a story to play in and gives a school or resort something visitors remember. Saurashtra has hot summers and a monsoon from about June to September, so we suggest galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts for themed pieces too.

sections.html:
Pick one main station as the centrepiece, such as a Forestia play station, and build the rest of the theme around it. Animal spring riders, such as our Dino Rider or Alligator Rider, work well in the toddler corner. Greens, browns and yellows from our roto-moulded shades keep the look consistent. Plant real trees and shrubs at the edges, outside the safe play areas, for shade. Resorts on the Gir side can carry the theme into benches from our Garden Decor range.

See our King Kong Play Park and Alligator Rider, or playground equipment in Rajkot.

faq.q: Do you make jungle-themed playground equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Our Forestia range is jungle-themed, and we also make animal spring riders and nature-inspired structures. We can combine them into one themed layout for your site.

faq.q: Can resorts near Gir order a themed play area?
faq.a: Yes. Share photos of the site and the theme you have in mind. Our design team will suggest pieces and colours and send a layout with the safe play area marked.

faq.q: How far is Junagadh from your factory?
faq.a: About 350 km from our factory in Vasai. We send the equipment by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in Gujarat. Our team plans the delivery once you approve the layout and quote.

intro: Kadapa lies in the Rayalaseema region of Andhra Pradesh, ringed by the Palakonda hills, with hot, dry weather for most of the year. Schools, colleges, municipal parks and housing layouts here often come to us with a fixed budget and ask what it can buy. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 830 km away, and delivers it by road.

A playground budget has to cover more than the equipment. Delivery, installation, foundations and the surface under the equipment all come out of the same amount. Buyers who spend everything on a large station sometimes end up with bare, hard ground beneath it. Tell us your budget along with the site size and age group, and we will suggest a plan that covers every part and leaves nothing half-done. We would rather plan a smaller play area done well.

sections.html:
Start with the surface. Rubber flooring under at least the fall zones of slides, swings and climbers belongs in the first order, since it protects children every day. Next, choose equipment for the main age group before adding pieces for others. Ask for installation and foundation work to be quoted along with the equipment, so nothing comes as a surprise later. On a tight budget, a few well-placed individual pieces with proper flooring serve children better than a big station on hard soil.

See our Curve Slide, or playground equipment in Tirupati.

faq.q: What should a playground budget include?
faq.a: The equipment, delivery, installation, foundation work and the surface under the play area. Share your total budget with us and we will suggest a plan that covers each part.

faq.q: Can we add more equipment later?
faq.a: Yes. We can mark space for future pieces on the layout drawing, so later additions fit without moving anything that is already installed. Many schools in Rayalaseema start with a few pieces and add more over two or three budget years.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Kadapa?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Kadapa by road, and our installation team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs it on site.

intro: Kakinada is a port city on the Godavari delta coast, with fertiliser plants, a planned layout and a hot, humid climate shaped by the Bay of Bengal. Schools, colleges, housing societies and municipal parks here ask us for playground equipment. FunPlay Systems makes it at our factory in Vasai, about 1,020 km away, and sends it to Andhra Pradesh by road.

Some schools and parks ask for play areas that children with disabilities can enjoy alongside their friends. A few simple choices make a big difference: a smooth path to the equipment, play panels at ground level and swings with proper support. Our design team can customise structures on request, so tell us about the children who will use the space. We will suggest pieces and a layout that let more of them join in.

sections.h: Making a play area easier for every child to use
sections.html:
Lay a firm, level path from the gate to the play area, with no steps, and run rubber flooring right up to it so a wheelchair or walker can reach the equipment. Choose some activities that work from the ground, such as play panels and low climbers. A mother-and-child swing lets a parent or carer swing together with a child who needs support. Keep quieter pieces away from busy ones for children who find crowds hard. In Kakinada's coastal air, galvanised frames resist rust.

See our Mother Child Swing and Wall Play range, or playground equipment in Rajahmundry.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground that children with disabilities can use?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us about the children who will use it. We suggest ground-level activities, supportive swings and a step-free path, and our design team can customise structures on request.

faq.q: Which surface works for wheelchairs?
faq.a: Rubber flooring laid on a firm, level base gives a smooth surface that wheels can cross, unlike sand or loose soil. Join it to a step-free path from the gate.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Kakinada?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Kakinada by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh. We can also suggest pieces for a mixed group of children when you share their ages and needs.
